title: Release Grace After the Full-Refund Window — Homesite Reservation
content:
A Homesite Reservation released shortly after the full-refund window has closed carries a release grace bonus, set by the calendar days from the last day of the full-refund window to the release date.

## The window it is measured from

The full-refund window runs the class's full-refund window days after the window start, the window start being the later of the reservation date and the day the required funds became complete; days are counted from the day after the window start, so the last day of the window is the window start plus the class's full-refund window days. The day the required funds became complete is the latest posting date of a payment received with the component reservation deposit, or, where the class carries a premium holding fee above zero, the later of that date and the latest posting date of a payment received with the component premium holding fee.

## Grace bands

| Release date, counted from the last day of the window | Release grace bonus |
|---|---|
| at most 2 days after the window | 15 percentage points |
| more than 2 but at most 5 days after the window | 5 percentage points |
| more than 5 days after the window | none |

## Date cases (hypothetical: window start 3 June, full-refund window 5 days, so the last day of the window is 8 June)

| Release date | Days after the window | Grace bonus |
|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 2 | 15 points |
| 11 June | 3 | 5 points |
| 13 June | 5 | 5 points |
| 14 June | 6 | none |
